content.title: Oppa is Life
content.text: T.O.P's interview wherein he mentioned his former group BIGBANG. T.O.P left the company when his exclusive contract with YG Entertainment expired in February 2022. T.O.P officially announced his withdrawal from BIGBANG in May 2023."I told the members that I could not cause any more harm to them, so I decided to leave the team."I am someone who has caused so much damage to BigBang and my former company (YG) because of my mistakes. That is why I have been saying that I will leave the team for many years now because I cannot cause any more damage to the agency and the members.I have to endure the criticism on my own, but if I were to return to the team, I would feel ashamed that the members would be labeled with my mistakes, and I have been so distressed by it.When I see comments from fans and others who want a reunion,, my heart aches. I wanted to make it clear, but for me, seeing pictures of my separated family (BigBang) is something that cannot be described in words unless you are the person involved.
